definition: to grip something tightly and not let go
description: On a stormy seaside promenade, a young man with wet curly hair, in a yellow raincoat, grey jumper, jeans and white trainers, leans far sideways against a metal railing in the strong wind, laughing with his fists up, as a paper coffee cup and leaves fly past. Behind him a woman in a dark coat holds on tightly to a lamp post, a couple sits on a bench, an umbrella blows away inside out and a dog stands by them. Big waves crash over the sea wall near beach huts and a pier, and the man comes closer as he laughs.

en.question: What is the woman in black doing?

de.answer: Sie hält sich an einem Laternenpfahl fest.
de.question: Was macht die Frau in Schwarz gerade?

es.answer: Se está agarrando a una farola.
